Overview

Wichita Falls is a city in TX with a population of 105,000. North Texas city with the Wichita Falls waterfall and Sheppard Air Force Base. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The population skews young, with a median age of 33.0.
